name: Pickup — Balas +5 (Poco Común)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo pickup centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 48×48.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon game collectible pickup item centered on a fully transparent background. The item is a floating AMMO PACK containing 5 cartoon bullet cartridges. The cartridges are short fat golden-brass cylinders (bullet casings) with bright glowing green-lime tips (#44DD00), arranged in a fan/radial pattern. Each cartridge has a bold dark charcoal outline, warm cel-shaded brass body (bright gold highlight, amber midtone, dark shadow). The green tips glow brightly, emitting a vibrant lime-green aura around the cluster — more intense than the 3-bullet version. A small white sparkle star above. The cluster is visibly bigger and more impressive than a 3-bullet pack. Cartoon proportions — chunky and readable as AMMUNITION. Transparent background, nothing else.
